# `targetable` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "targetable" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/targetable/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (debug tools and docs). |
| `points` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Lock points; the first is the main one (the lock and HUD marker sit there). |
| `points[].id` | id | required | Name of the point, unique on the profile (e.g. "chest"). |
| `points[].at` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Offset from the entity’s origin, metres (x, y, z). |
| `priority` | integer -10–10 | `0` | Pick preference: higher is picked over a lower one at a similar angle and distance (a bell is lower than a foe). |
